import seaborn as sns

# Load data

# Create a plot to show the distribution of dog breeds in Zurich

sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title

plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a plot to show the distribution of dog breeds in Zurich
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10)
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
